problem: 列出看诊次数超过5次的患者ID和看诊次数，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS visit_cnt FROM medical_encounters GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

problem: 算算每个科室的平均床位使用率，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT name, (total_beds - available_beds) / total_beds AS avg_bed_usage_rate FROM departments_wards WHERE total_beds > 0;

problem: 找出平均绩效评分最高的职位，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT job_title FROM medical_staff GROUP BY job_title ORDER BY AVG(performance_score) DESC LIMIT 1;

problem: 看看每个月新增多少患者，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS reg_month, COUNT(*) AS patient_cnt FROM patient_master_index GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY reg_month;

problem: 算算哪种医嘱类型用得最多，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM medical_orders GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

problem: 看看哪个护士执行的医嘱数量最多，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT executing_nurse_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM medical_orders WHERE execution_status = '已执行' GROUP BY executing_nurse_id ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

problem: 看看每年医保支付总额是多少，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT YEAR(transaction_date) AS year, SUM(insurance_paid) AS total_insurance FROM billing_transactions GROUP BY YEAR(transaction_date) ORDER BY year;

problem: 找出每个科室床位数最多的那个科室，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT name, total_beds FROM departments_wards ORDER BY total_beds DESC LIMIT 1;

problem: 查查同一科室里绩效前3的员工，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT department_id, staff_id, staff_name, performance_score FROM (SELECT department_id, staff_id, staff_name, performance_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY performance_score DESC) AS rn FROM medical_staff WHERE is_active = 1) t WHERE rn <= 3;

problem: 找出患者中年龄最大和最小的，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, age FROM (SELECT patient_id, patient_name, age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS rk_desc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age ASC) AS rk_asc FROM patient_master_index WHERE delete_flag = 'N') t WHERE rk_desc = 1 OR rk_asc = 1;

problem: 统计医保余额大于平均值的患者，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, insurance_balance FROM patient_master_index WHERE insurance_balance > (SELECT AVG(insurance_balance) FROM patient_master_index WHERE delete_flag = 'N') AND delete_flag = 'N';

problem: 看看哪些医生的绩效高于科室平均绩效，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_name, s.department_id, s.performance_score FROM medical_staff s WHERE s.is_active = 1 AND s.job_title LIKE '%医师%' AND s.performance_score > (SELECT AVG(performance_score) FROM medical_staff WHERE department_id = s.department_id AND is_active = 1);
